answer.label: quantized
answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. Top-1 agreement is 0.955 and sequence agreement is 0.688, both squarely in the quantized range (0.945-0.955 and 0.67-0.70). KL is 0.030 and TV is 0.038, slightly below the quantized ranges (0.039-0.071 and 0.048-0.055) but still the lowest-change profile and far under the fine-tuned (KL 0.081+, top-1 at most 0.938) and system-prompted (KL 0.197+) ranges. The nonzero values rule out base. The Token-DiFR gap of 0.052 is a little above the quantized range (0.03-0.04) but well below fine-tuned (0.10+). The raw-score shift ratio of 3.2 is higher than the quantized 2.2-2.3 and falls in the fine-tuned and system-prompted ranges, which adds some uncertainty. Overall the small logit change fits quantization best.
